title: Two-tier eval gate separation
prose: Deterministic Tier-1 structural evals (Pester) are always-on; Tier-2 LLM (waza) evals are never part of the deterministic gate. npm test, scripts/validate.ps1, and npm run eval must never invoke a waza/LLM run; Tier-2 runs only via the opt-in npm run eval:llm (Invoke-WazaEvals.ps1), which requires auth and incurs premium cost.
description: Keeps CI deterministic and offline: no premium-cost, auth-dependent, non-deterministic LLM call can enter the always-on gate. Enforced by Test-Evals.ps1 (Tier-1 only) vs Invoke-WazaEvals.ps1 (Tier-2 only).
